sentences.en: In 1959, after nearly a century and a half of British colonial rule,
sentences.zh: 1959年，在经历了近一个半世纪的英国殖民统治后，

sentences.en: the people of Singapore took the first step toward their independence.
sentences.zh: 新加坡人民迈出了走向独立的第一步。

sentences.en: They voted to run their own internal government.
sentences.zh: 他们投票决定建立自己的内部政府。

sentences.en: For 14 years since British colonial rule was restored after the Second World War,
sentences.zh: 在第二次世界大战后英国殖民统治恢复的14年里，

sentences.en: a series of colonial administrators have ruled and ordered our lives.
sentences.zh: 一系列殖民地行政长官统治并支配着我们的生活。

sentences.en: Well, times have changed and will stay changed.
sentences.zh: 好吧，时代已经改变，并将持续改变。

sentences.en: We, the people of Singapore, have decided to run the affairs of Singapore.
sentences.zh: 我们，新加坡人民，已经决定管理新加坡的事务。

sentences.en: It was a joyous moment, but they inherited a difficult situation.
sentences.zh: 那是一个欢乐的时刻，但他们继承的是一个困难的局面。

sentences.en: All of us want a better and a fuller life.
sentences.zh: 我们所有人都想要更好、更充实的生活。

sentences.en: But a rise in the standard of living of our people cannot be created overnight.
sentences.zh: 但人民生活水平的提高不可能一蹴而就。

sentences.en: Singapore was bombed heavily by Japan during the Second World War
sentences.zh: 第二次世界大战期间，新加坡遭到日本的猛烈轰炸，

sentences.en: and again by the Allies after Singapore fell to the Japanese.
sentences.zh: 而在新加坡沦陷于日本之后，又遭到了盟军的轰炸。

sentences.en: A lot of its infrastructure was in ruins, including the port,
sentences.zh: 其大量基础设施沦为废墟，包括港口，

sentences.en: which had brought foreign goods and a multi-ethnic, multilingual population of people
sentences.zh: 几个世纪以来，正是这个港口为岛上带来了外国商品
以及多民族、多语言的人口。
没有港口就意味着没有工作。

sentences.en: Most of the island's residents were living in unpermitted makeshift houses
sentences.zh: 岛上大多数居民住在违章搭建的临时房屋里，

sentences.en: crammed into crowded villages throughout the island.
sentences.zh: 挤在全岛各处拥挤的村庄中。

sentences.en: If you don't know, the country of Singapore is tiny.
sentences.zh: 如果你不知道的话，新加坡这个国家非常小。

sentences.en: Today, the entire nation is really just one city.
sentences.zh: 今天，整个国家实际上就是一座城市。

sentences.en: It takes less than 45 minutes to drive across the island, with traffic.
sentences.zh: 在有交通的情况下，开车横穿全岛不到45分钟。

sentences.en: But in the 1950s, there were villages.
sentences.zh: 但在20世纪50年代，那里还有村庄。

sentences.en: And those villages were known as Kampongs, a local Malay word.
sentences.zh: 这些村庄被称为“甘榜”（Kampong），这是一个马来语词汇。

sentences.en: She's a Fulbright National Geographic fellow and has spent the last four months in Singapore.
sentences.zh: 她是富布赖特国家地理研究员，在新加坡度过了过去四个月。

sentences.en: Kampong communities were strong and close-knit, but the living wasn't easy.
sentences.zh: 甘榜社区虽然紧密团结，但生活并不容易。

sentences.en: Multiple families might share one toilet or one kitchen.
sentences.zh: 多个家庭可能共用一个厕所或一个厨房。

sentences.en: Many of the Kampongs relied on gas for lighting and cooking,
sentences.zh: 许多甘榜依靠煤气进行照明和烹饪，

sentences.en: and most houses were made of superflammable palm leaves or wood with roofs made of sheet metal.
sentences.zh: 大多数房屋是用极易燃烧的棕榈叶或木头建造的，屋顶则是铁皮做的。

sentences.en: The government wanted to raise the quality of life for the people.
sentences.zh: 政府想要提高人民的生活质量。

sentences.en: They rebuilt the port and created factory jobs.
sentences.zh: 他们重建了港口并创造了工厂就业机会。

sentences.en: They made all the kids learn English so that Singapore could feel united under one language.
sentences.zh: 他们让所有孩子学习英语，以便新加坡能在一种语言下感到团结。

sentences.en: But the biggest undertaking of all was to get the people out of thatched-roof huts and into modern housing.
sentences.zh: 但所有工程中最艰巨的，是将人们从茅草屋搬进现代住房。

sentences.en: And one of the biggest challenges would be doing it with extremely limited land space.
sentences.zh: 而最大的挑战之一，是在极其有限的土地空间内完成这项工作。

sentences.en: In 1960, they formed the Housing and Development Board, or HDB.
And just five years later, they had already housed 400,000 people.
sentences.zh: 仅仅五年后，他们就已经安置了40万人。

sentences.en: Well over 400,000 people, a quarter of Singapore's population,
sentences.zh: 在过去五年里，超过40万人，即新加坡四分之一的人口，

sentences.en: has been rehoused in the last five years in these bright, modern, airy flats.
sentences.zh: 被重新安置在这些明亮、现代、通风的公寓里。

sentences.en: Nowhere in the world, except in Russia and West Germany,
sentences.zh: 世界上除了俄罗斯和西德，

sentences.en: is the rate of rehousing faster than in Singapore.
sentences.zh: 没有哪个地方的重新安置速度比新加坡更快。

sentences.en: The HDB achieved this pretty amazing feat by going vertical.
sentences.zh: 建屋发展局通过向高空发展，实现了这一令人惊叹的壮举。

sentences.en: When planning for a growing population, most urban planners expand their cities outward.
sentences.zh: 在规划人口增长时，大多数城市规划者会向外扩张城市。

sentences.en: But in land-limited Singapore, that is not an option.
sentences.zh: 但在土地有限的新加坡，这不是一个选择。

sentences.en: Today, Singapore's tallest public housing buildings are 50 stories high,
sentences.zh: 今天，新加坡最高的公共住房建筑有50层高，

sentences.en: But from the very beginning, the Housing and Development Board went vertical.
sentences.zh: 但从一开始，建屋发展局就选择了向高空发展。

sentences.en: The people of Singapore demand high standards of their governments,
sentences.zh: 新加坡人民对政府要求很高，

sentences.en: and they are prepared to work hard and are capable of high skills.
sentences.zh: 他们准备好努力工作，并且具备高超的技能。

sentences.en: For them, the sky is the limit.
sentences.zh: 对他们来说，天空才是极限。

sentences.en: Singapore is acquiring the one hallmark of a great civilized community.
sentences.zh: 新加坡正在获得一个伟大文明社区的标志。

sentences.en: Magnificent buildings, plus comparable workers' housing.
sentences.zh: 宏伟的建筑，加上与之相称的工人住房。

sentences.en: Today, Singapore is the third richest nation in the world.
sentences.zh: 今天，新加坡是世界上第三富有的国家。

sentences.en: And 80% of Singaporeans still live in these tall, cement HDB flats.
sentences.zh: 而80%的新加坡人仍然住在这些高大的水泥建屋局公寓里。

sentences.en: There's about 10,000 public housing buildings on the island.
sentences.zh: 岛上大约有10,000栋公共住房建筑。

sentences.en: And new flats are going up all the time.
sentences.zh: 而且新的公寓一直在兴建。

sentences.en: It's not the glitzy, futuristic Singapore skyline you see in movies like Crazy Rich Asians.
sentences.zh: 这并不是你在《摘金奇缘》等电影中看到的那些浮华、充满未来感的新加坡天际线。

sentences.en: The buildings are tall and cement, with housing block numbers painted boldly down the sides,
sentences.zh: 这些建筑高大且由水泥建成，侧面大胆地漆着住房编号，

sentences.en: helping Singaporeans locate themselves in the monotonous sea of nearly identical buildings.
sentences.zh: 帮助新加坡人在几乎一模一样的建筑单调海洋中找到自己的位置。

sentences.en: Throughout the 1960s and 70s, HDB public housing developments sprung up all over the country.
sentences.zh: 在整个20世纪60年代和70年代，建屋局的公共住房开发项目在全国各地如雨后春笋般涌现。

sentences.en: Ku Ihun is a historian in Singapore.
sentences.zh: 库伊洪（Ku Ihun）是新加坡的一位历史学家。

sentences.en: She was born in 1966, and has lived in HDB flats for most of her life.
sentences.zh: 她出生于1966年，大半辈子都住在建屋局的公寓里。

sentences.en: She remembers watching this housing crop up everywhere on the island.
sentences.zh: 她记得看着这种住房在岛上各处兴起。

sentences.en: They weren't all designed exactly the same, but pretty close.
sentences.zh: 它们的设计并不完全相同，但非常接近。

sentences.en: Design style is different, but what doesn't change is basically everything become like a matchbox.
sentences.zh: 设计风格不同，但不变的是基本上一切都变得像火柴盒一样。

sentences.en: So you're living in a little hole inside a concrete structure.
sentences.zh: 所以你住在一个混凝土结构里的一个小洞里。

sentences.en: As people moved into these drab concrete towers, a lot of them missed the vibe of their old communities,
sentences.zh: 当人们搬进这些单调的混凝土塔楼时，许多人怀念他们旧社区的氛围，

sentences.en: what they called the Kampong spirit.
sentences.zh: 也就是他们所说的“甘榜精神”。

sentences.en: But there was a lot to like about their new homes,
sentences.zh: 但他们的新家也有很多值得喜欢的地方，

sentences.en: like having their own bathrooms and kitchens with electricity and plumbing.
sentences.zh: 比如拥有自己的浴室和厨房，还有电力和管道设施。

sentences.en: A place where they can have their own privacy,
sentences.zh: 一个他们可以拥有自己隐私的地方，

sentences.en: a place where they don't get flooded every time it rains, you know.
sentences.zh: 一个下雨时不会被淹的地方，你知道的。

sentences.en: And so people moved in, and the government kept building.
sentences.zh: 于是人们搬了进去，政府继续建设。

sentences.en: And then the building just kept getting higher over the years.
sentences.zh: 多年来，建筑也越来越高。

sentences.en: But despite the privacy the architecture afforded,
sentences.zh: 但尽管建筑提供了隐私，
伊洪并不总是感到孤独。

sentences.en: As a kid growing up in HDB flats,
sentences.zh: 作为一个在建屋局公寓长大的孩子，

sentences.en: she remembers seeing shadowy figures floating above her bed.
sentences.zh: 她记得看到过阴影般的轮廓在床上方漂浮。

sentences.en: She asked her mom about it.
So when I was very young, I told my mom,
sentences.zh: 所以我很小的时候，我告诉妈妈，

sentences.en: I said, why is it that I see dark images above me?
sentences.zh: 我说，为什么我会在上方看到黑暗的影像？

sentences.en: And then she said, silly girl, this used to be a cemetery.
sentences.zh: 然后她说，傻孩子，这里以前是个墓地。

sentences.en: Of the four apartments Ihun has lived in,
sentences.zh: 在伊洪住过的四套公寓中，

sentences.en: two of them have been on old cemeteries.
That might seem like bad luck.
But in Singapore, where land is scarce,
sentences.zh: 但在土地稀缺的新加坡，

sentences.en: it's not unlikely for apartment buildings to be built on land
sentences.zh: 公寓楼建在不久前还是墓地的土地上，

sentences.en: that was graveyards not too long ago.
But building on top of a graveyard has its complications.
sentences.zh: 但在墓地上盖房子有其复杂性。

sentences.en: And in one cemetery, called Pek San Thang,
sentences.zh: 在一个叫碧山亭（Pek San Thang）的墓地，

sentences.en: the new housing development disrupted more than just the dead.
sentences.zh: 新的住房开发项目不仅打扰了死者，

sentences.en: But it disrupted a way of life.
sentences.zh: 还破坏了一种生活方式。

sentences.en: Yeah, I'm Kwan, Kwan Yu King.
sentences.zh: 是的，我是关，关玉庆（音译）。

sentences.en: Growing up in the 50s and 60s, Mr. Kwan was a city boy.
sentences.zh: 在50和60年代长大的关先生是个城市男孩。

sentences.en: But his dad would bring him the eight miles from their home
sentences.zh: 但他父亲会带他走八英里，从他们家，
靠近新加坡日益发展的市中心，

sentences.en: to the overgrown rainforest of Pek San Thang Cemetery
sentences.zh: 来到碧山亭墓地杂草丛生的雨林中，

sentences.en: to pray at the graves of their family and friends.
sentences.zh: 去祭拜他们家人和朋友的坟墓。

sentences.en: When I was a kid, I was a young boy,
sentences.zh: 当我还是个孩子，还是个小男孩的时候，

sentences.en: wandering around the hillsides, you know,
sentences.zh: 在山坡上四处游荡，你知道的，

sentences.en: And they believed that if the dead were well taken care of,
sentences.zh: 他们相信，如果死者得到妥善照顾，

sentences.en: it not only meant peace for the departed,
sentences.zh: 这不仅意味着逝者的安宁，

sentences.en: it could also bring direct benefits to the descendants.
sentences.zh: 还能给后代带来直接的好处。

sentences.en: So Mr. Kwan kept going as he got older.
sentences.zh: 所以关先生长大后一直坚持去。

sentences.en: And going to the cemetery wasn't just a family affair.
sentences.zh: 而且去墓地不仅仅是家庭事务。

sentences.en: Chinese migrants to Singapore set up social service organizations
sentences.zh: 来到新加坡的华人移民建立了社会服务组织，

sentences.en: to help take care of their community
sentences.zh: 以帮助照顾他们的社区，

sentences.en: from the cradle to the grave and beyond.
sentences.zh: 从摇篮到坟墓，甚至更远。

sentences.en: Mr. Kwan and his friends would wander the untamed hillsides
sentences.zh: 关先生和他的朋友们会在未开垦的山坡上漫步，

sentences.en: to the graves of their long-dead community members.
sentences.zh: 前往他们早已去世的社区成员的坟墓。

sentences.en: There they'd burn incense and fake paper money,
sentences.zh: 在那里，他们会焚香和烧纸钱，

sentences.en: things they thought that the dead might need in the afterlife.
sentences.zh: 他们认为死者在来世可能需要这些东西。

sentences.en: And then they'd just hang out at the grave.
sentences.zh: 然后他们就只是在坟墓边闲逛。

sentences.en: So after all the prayers are said and done,
sentences.zh: 所以所有的祈祷都说完做完之后，

sentences.en: we have a lovely meal of roast pork,
sentences.zh: 我们会吃一顿美味的烤肉、

sentences.en: roast duck, you know, and so on.
And it was a wonderful event.
I mean, we kids look forward to that, actually.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我们这些孩子其实很期待那个。

sentences.en: When you hear Mr. Kwan talk about going to the cemetery,
sentences.zh: 当你听到关先生谈论去墓地时，

sentences.en: you start to get why he enjoyed it.
sentences.zh: 你就开始明白他为什么喜欢它了。

sentences.en: It was a nice change from the congestion and cement of the city.
sentences.zh: 那是对城市拥挤和水泥环境的一种很好的调剂。

sentences.en: And it wasn't just the natural scenery that was impressive.
sentences.zh: 而且令人印象深刻的不仅仅是自然风光。

sentences.en: People would spend a fortune on big, elaborate memorials
sentences.zh: 人们会花大钱建造巨大、精致的纪念碑，

sentences.en: with stone lions and meticulous carvings.
sentences.zh: 配有石狮子和细致的雕刻。

sentences.en: Pak San Teng Cemetery was sprawling with these huge, ornate tombs.
sentences.zh: 碧山亭墓地里到处都是这些巨大、华丽的坟墓。

sentences.en: A tomb like that could easily be bigger than a three-bedroom HDB apartment today.
sentences.zh: 那样的坟墓很容易比今天的三居室建屋局公寓还要大。

sentences.en: And Mr. Kwan is describing just a single family grave.
sentences.zh: 而关先生描述的仅仅是一个单人家庭墓。

sentences.en: On top of that, Pak San Teng had a lot of shared graves.
sentences.zh: 除此之外，碧山亭还有很多合葬墓。

sentences.en: One big tombstone would mark a huge area
sentences.zh: 一块巨大的墓碑会标记出一大片区域，

sentences.en: where members of a professional or social group were buried together.
sentences.zh: 专业或社会团体的成员被埋葬在一起。

sentences.en: At Pak San Teng, there were plots for all sorts of groups.
sentences.zh: 在碧山亭，有各种团体的墓地。

sentences.en: We have the Taylors Association, the Pork Sellers Association,
sentences.zh: 我们有裁缝协会、猪肉商协会、

sentences.en: the Opera Singers Association, the, uh, I mean, you name it.
sentences.zh: 歌剧演员协会，那个，呃，我是说，你能想到的都有。

sentences.en: An ideal Chinese tomb is supposed to be on a hill
sentences.zh: 理想的中国坟墓应该在山上，

sentences.en: so that the fortunes of the deceased can run down to future generations.
sentences.zh: 这样逝者的福气才能流向后代。

sentences.en: In China and in the Chinese diaspora,
the words hill and cemetery were pretty much used interchangeably.
sentences.zh: “山”和“墓地”这两个词几乎是可以互换使用的。

sentences.en: San of Pak San Teng means hill.
The name translates to pavilions on the jade hills,
sentences.zh: 这个名字翻译过来是“碧绿山丘上的亭子”，

sentences.en: a reference to the graveyard's 12 covered structures
sentences.zh: 指的是墓地里那12座带顶的建筑，

sentences.en: where visitors could rest and eat after making offerings at the graves.
sentences.zh: 访客在墓前祭拜后，可以在那里休息和进食。

sentences.en: Mr. Kwan remembers these pavilions well,
sentences.zh: 关先生对这些亭子记忆犹新，

sentences.en: but that doesn't mean he knew his way around the graveyard.
sentences.zh: 但这并不意味着他熟悉墓地里的路。

sentences.en: With all those grand tombs, the cemetery was enormous, 324 acres.
sentences.zh: 墓地里到处都是宏伟的坟墓，占地面积巨大，足有324英亩。

sentences.en: That's about four times the size of Disneyland
sentences.zh: 这大约是迪士尼乐园面积的四倍，

sentences.en: in a country half the size of L.A.
sentences.zh: 而这片墓地所在的国家面积只有洛杉矶的一半大。

sentences.en: Sometimes the driver of the bus or the lorry bringing us there
sentences.zh: 有时，载我们去那里的巴士或货车司机，

sentences.en: and it would lose his way.
And then he would drive around in a circle.
sentences.zh: 然后他就会在原地绕圈子。

sentences.en: We have to get some of the villagers to come out and guide us.
sentences.zh: 我们不得不叫一些村民出来给我们带路。

sentences.en: When Mr. Kwan says they would get villagers to come out and guide them,
sentences.zh: 当关先生说他们会叫村民出来带路时，

sentences.en: he doesn't mean people from a nearby village.
sentences.zh: 他指的并不是附近村庄的人。

sentences.en: He means people who lived in the graveyard.
sentences.zh: 他指的是住在墓地里的人。

sentences.en: So people were kind of living among the tombstones, is that correct?
sentences.zh: 所以人们算是住在墓碑之间，是这样吗？

sentences.en: Pek Santhang was, in fact, a cemetery full of life.
sentences.zh: 事实上，碧山亭是一个充满生气的墓地。

sentences.en: It was a self-sufficient village that began almost 100 years
sentences.zh: 它是一个自给自足的村庄，早在关先生开始造访这里

sentences.en: When members of Singapore's growing Cantonese community
sentences.zh: 当新加坡日益壮大的广东社群

sentences.en: realized they needed more space to bury their dead,
sentences.zh: 意识到他们需要更多空间来安葬逝者时，

sentences.en: they purchased land on what was then the edge of town.
sentences.zh: 他们买下了当时位于城镇边缘的这片土地。

sentences.en: And as the cemetery grew, so did the village.
sentences.zh: 随着墓地的扩大，村庄也随之发展起来。

sentences.en: An active graveyard meant there were jobs to be had.
sentences.zh: 一个活跃的墓地意味着有工作机会。

sentences.en: Graves had to be dug, tombstones carved, refreshments sold to mourners.
sentences.zh: 需要有人挖墓、雕刻墓碑，还要向送葬者出售茶点。

sentences.en: So people built thatched roof homes right there among the graves.
sentences.zh: 于是人们就在坟墓之间盖起了茅草屋。

sentences.en: This actually happened in a lot of big cemeteries
sentences.zh: 这种情况实际上发生在许多大型墓地中，

sentences.en: that sprawled across the tiny island.
sentences.zh: 它们散布在这个小岛的各个角落。

sentences.en: The living just kind of lived alongside the dead.
sentences.zh: 生者就这样与死者比邻而居。

sentences.en: By the 1970s, Pek Santhang Village had almost 2,000 residents.
sentences.zh: 到了20世纪70年代，碧山亭村已有近2000名居民。

sentences.en: There was a large Chinese-style gate at the entrance to the village.
sentences.zh: 村口有一座中式大牌坊。

sentences.en: The village had its own clinic, convenience stores with thatched and tin roofs.
sentences.zh: 村里有自己的诊所，还有盖着茅草和铁皮屋顶的杂货店。
